The SEEM Group hosted Dr. Daniel Wamriew from the Seismic Wave Analysis Group at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology for a seminar titled *From Waveforms to Coordinates: Generative Localization of Microseismic Events*.

Dr. Wamriew presented work using generative diffusion models to estimate microseismic-event locations directly from waveform data. The approach offers a data-driven alternative to conventional localization workflows and is relevant to subsurface monitoring for CO₂ storage, hydraulic fracturing, and geothermal energy.

The visit concluded with discussions on potential collaboration between SEEM and KAUST in AI-driven, real-time seismic monitoring.
